name: Rebecca
source:
Some say her hair isn't pink because of dye, but because of the magic that flows through her veins.

A talented but inexperienced pervert, Bex (as her friends call her) likes to push her abilities to the limit and beyond.

Using her beauty as a spell, she channels her talents to intoxicating effect.

With a burning desire inside, but with no one to guide her, Bex is alone on her perverted journey... or so she thinks.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Rebecca]DumbKoala[/url]]
